# XADO Singapore

> XADO Singapore is the brand site for XADO engine treatments and oils in Singapore. XADO is a European lubricant and engine-treatment brand founded in 1991, made under XADO Germany and XADO Lube B.V. (Netherlands) licences and sold in more than 100 countries. In Singapore it is distributed by Rev Solutions Pte Ltd and fitted by 11 authorised workshops. Drivers ask for XADO at their next oil change; the online store is shop.xado-shop.sg.

Key facts:
- Product: XADO Revitalizant(R) treatments (Atomic Metal Conditioner, EX120 for gearboxes and power steering) and engine oils with revitalizant built in (Atomic Oil, Luxury Drive, LX AMC Black Edition).
- What XADO says it does: forms a protective ceramic-metal layer on worn friction surfaces. These are manufacturer claims; XADO does not repair broken or cracked parts.
- Where to get it: 11 authorised XADO workshops in Yishun, Ang Mo Kio, Kaki Bukit, Ubi, Bukit Batok, Jurong East and Woodlands.
- XADO Singapore WhatsApp: +65 9339 1185.
- Distributor: Rev Solutions Pte Ltd, +65 6876 1456, enquiries@revsolutions.com.sg. Office: 1 Tampines North Drive 1 #07-20, Singapore 528559.
